summary: List all available permission templates for a Project
description: Returns the permission templates available for use on the specified project. Users with the Directory 'Create and Edit Users' granular permission can retrieve just the templates they are permitted to assign by passing `filters[assignables_only]=true`.

parameters.name: filters[assignables_only]
parameters.description: When true, returns only the permission templates the requesting user is permitted to assign.

id.description: The ID of the Permission Template

name.description: The name of the Permission Template

project_specific.description: If the Permission Template is project specific

category.description: The category of the Permission Template
